name: jumpseller
description: Jumpseller developer tools — REST API, Liquid themes, and MCP server context for Gemini CLI.

settings.name: Jumpseller Login Key
settings.description: Login key for the Jumpseller MCP server (Admin Panel → Account Settings → API Tokens).

settings.name: Jumpseller Auth Token
settings.description: Auth token for the Jumpseller MCP server (Admin Panel → Account Settings → API Tokens).

skills.name: jumpseller-api
skills.description: Use when working with the Jumpseller REST API to manage products, orders, customers, categories, pages, webhooks, or any store resource.

skills.name: jumpseller-liquid
skills.description: Use when building or editing Jumpseller themes, Liquid templates, partials, or theme components.

skills.name: jumpseller-mcp
skills.description: Use when managing a Jumpseller store through MCP tools or conversational store operations.

skills.name: jumpseller-cli
skills.description: Use when using the Jumpseller CLI to manage store credentials or do local theme development — export, import, watch, apply, list, rename, or delete themes.
